BatchDeleteMessage.description_en: Deletes messages from a queue in a batch. A maximum of 16 messages can be deleted at a time
BatchDeleteMessage.description_zh: 批量删除队列中的消息，最多可删除16条

BatchPeekMessage.description_en: Batch peeks at messages in a queue without changing the message status
BatchPeekMessage.description_zh: 批量查看队列中的消息，不改变消息状态

BatchReceiveMessage.description_en: Batch receives up to 16 messages from a specified queue for consumption
BatchReceiveMessage.description_zh: 从指定队列中批量获取最多16条消息进行消费

BatchSendMessage.description_en: Sends a batch of up to 16 messages to a specified queue, with a total size not exceeding 64 KB
BatchSendMessage.description_zh: 向指定队列批量发送最多16条消息，总大小不超过64KB

ChangeMessageVisibility.description_en: Extends or shortens the invisibility period of a message that is in the Inactive state
ChangeMessageVisibility.description_zh: 用于延长或缩短处于 Inactive 状态的消息的不可见时间

PublishMessage.description_en: Publishes a message to a specified topic. The message is pushed to all subscribed endpoints
PublishMessage.description_zh: 向指定的主题发布消息，消息将被推送给所有订阅的Endpoint

SendMessage.description_en: Sends a message to a specified queue with support for delay and priority settings
SendMessage.description_zh: 向指定的队列发送一条消息，支持设置延迟和优先级
